name: Devilled Tomatoes
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Wipe, peel, and cut tomatoes in slices.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper, dredge with flour, and sauté in butter.

Place on a hot platter and pour over the dressing made by creaming the butter, adding dry ingredients, yolk of egg rubbed to a paste, egg beaten slightly, and vinegar, then cooking over hot water, stirring constantly until it thickens.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
